checks_performed: Read every word of all 12 final drafts, including 13.6 after writer completion. Parsed 89 shell fences with sh -n; resolved 68 local or download destinations and 22 full-file includes. No missing files or shell syntax errors.
Read all referenced SVG text labels through XML for source/prose contradictions. Complete rendered visual and browser checks remain root responsibility.

All network example hashes match the successful CI 43334222277 build report. Read all 12 runtime cases: kernel 7.0.0-1017-azure, x86_64, helper-owned veth, generic XDP and AF_XDP copy mode. Physical runtime was not exercised. This audit did not rerun privileged tests.

Progression retains kernel 6.12.96-hfs1-v8 and its matched source, configuration and output tree. The kernelrelease query explicitly passes LOCALVERSION=. No second kernel or unrelated headers are introduced.

Checked finite readiness/count/deadline commands, namespace ownership and collision refusal, cleanup and ordinary UDP listener requirements. Passive capture and redirection distinguish packet reception from reply service.

Checked decoder bounds, byte order, options/fragments/checksum limits, count versus unique sequence sets, exact eight-byte payload, marker selectivity and missing-XSK PASS fallback against actual code.

Checked GENET MMIO descriptors versus RAM payloads, DMA address spaces, streaming mapping lifetime, refill failure and NAPI claims against pinned source. Counter and IRQ correlation limits are explicit.

Checked TPACKET block acquire/release, batch count and deadline limits, and the retained kernel copy. Checked AF_XDP queue discovery, offsets, FILL/RX/TX/COMPLETION ownership, need-wakeup, EBUSY retries, owned detach and destructor order against the complete implementation.

Checked 13.6 sequential workload, readiness delay, process CPU limitations, upper-middle median convention and successful-reply-only RTT. Passive capture remains a separate comparison. Direct hardware PMDs, bifurcated drivers and the AF_XDP PMD are distinguished, without an untested speedup or device-unbind instruction.

Reread repaired 12.2 and all added commands. The route query uses the actual Mac test peer and bound Pi source; selected dev must match IFACE. Another egress path is explicitly excluded from GENET TX evidence, without changing routes.

findings.issue: The original physical TX exercise assumed that binding the UDP endpoint to PI_WIRED_IP forced Ethernet egress. Linux route selection can use Wi-Fi despite source binding.
findings.requested_fix: Query ip route get using the actual Mac peer and PI_WIRED_IP source; require selected dev == IFACE before claiming GENET TX. Retain another path only as application/source evidence.
findings.resolution: Root repaired the lesson and refreshed its separate acceptance report. Audit reread confirms the route query, device gate and explicit non-GENET alternative.

limitations: No physical Pi boot, GENET, PHY, DMA, hardware zero-copy or performance evidence was added. Existing CI results apply to their recorded software environment.
The auditor changed no lesson, acceptance hash, shared code, Git state or deployment. Only this audit JSON was written.
Root completes page acceptance, rendered/browser, download/archive, deployment and final metadata checks.
